import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Trim whitespace from text columns and standardize labels
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (possible commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''))
    # Keep the id column as required
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
